text: Chemistry is a fundamental natural science that studies the composition, structure, properties, and change laws of substances, as well as their applications. It is known as the "central science", connecting multiple disciplines such as physics, biology, materials science, and medicine. It is a core field for understanding natural phenomena and promoting technological innovation. From drugs and detergents in daily life, to energy materials and catalysts in industrial production, and pollution control in environmental protection, the presence of chemistry can be seen everywhere.
